text:
maya: Heads-up — saw a pronounced p95 tail in eu-west this morning after we flipped edge routing for the new quantized-8 model. dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dash/bench/edge-latency (perm: eng-ml)
perf-bot: Automated summary (08:12): edge routing enabled -> overall p50 ~+5ms, p95 +70-120ms in eu-west vs baseline. See quick stats below.
jorge: Can you paste the raw numbers (p50/p95) per region + GPU? need to understand whether it's infra (network) or kernel choice.
sasha: quick paste from the perf job (1000 requests per region, H100/seq<=512, 8-bit quant):
```
region   | gpu  | routing  | p50(ms) | p95(ms) | tokens/s
us-east  | H100 | edge     | 30      | 85      | 950
us-east  | H100 | central  | 28      | 78      | 980
us-west  | H100 | edge     | 34      | 140     | 880
us-west  | H100 | central  | 29      | 95      | 920
eu-west  | H100 | edge     | 60      | 320     | 720
eu-west  | H100 | central  | 42      | 110     | 880
```
lin: Interesting — eu-west tail is huge on edge. Did we change kernel selection there? last week eu-west used cuBLAS path, this rollout enabled Triton custom fused-kernels on H100 for perf. Triton tends to lower median but can amplify tail for long sequences when GPU work queues pile up.
jorge: Do we have KV cache hit-rate and routing fanout numbers? high fanout -> more cross-region traffic and serialization.
ops-bot: Current routing config: `{policy: "latency_then_cost", edge_percent: 0.6, cross_region_fallback: true}`. KV cache global replication: disabled in eu-west (local only).
sasha: KV hit-rate during the run: us-east 92%, us-west 88%, eu-west 63%. eu-west had more cold-starts due to cache misses + bursty traffic at 07:50.
maya: So likely combo: lower KV hits + Triton kernel + edge hop network variance. Need to isolate. Action proposal: 1) rerun bench with kernel pinned to cuBLAS in eu-west, 2) force full-local routing (no edge bounce) for eu-west, 3) run longer tail test (10k reqs) to get stable p95. Anyone want to run step 1+2?
sasha: I'll kick off the runs. command I'll use: `bench-run --model quant8-v2 --regions eu-west,us-west,us-east --gpu H100 --pin-kernel cuBLAS --routing local,edge --requests 10000 --seed 42` and will attach CSV. ETA ~ 25m.
jorge: Also add a run on A100 for comparison (same config) — want to see whether kernel implementation differences across card generations matter for tails.
lin: add a small profile trace for slow tails: `--trace-slow > 200ms` so we can capture stack + kernel names.
maya: Awesome. If eu-west improves with cuBLAS/local routing then we can rollback Triton for that region and file a triangle ticket with infra/serving to debug Triton queue behavior.
ops-bot: Scheduled job created: job-id rwd-bench-1759991112-01. Slack will post results.
sasha: Uploaded preliminary CSV and a short chart (private): https://redwood.internal/files/rwd-bench-1759991112-01.csv. Initial quick look: pin cuBLAS reduced eu-west p95 from 320ms -> 115ms (edge) and to 78ms when routing local-only.
jorge: Nice. Once full 10k runs finish, let's sync and pick fallback policy (regional pin vs global default).
maya: Thanks — will follow up with change request if holds. :thumbsup:
